observations: Industrial flatbed sewing machine mounted on a wooden table with iron stand.
Brand name 'FLY' is embossed/printed on the machine arm, clearly readable.
Significant paint wear, rust spots, and surface corrosion visible on the machine head and table top.
Table surface shows cracks and stains, and no visible motor or pedal mechanism underneath.
A watermark 'INNARA COLLECTION' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' overlay the image, indicating a reposted/stock photo source.
Background shows a shop setting with people, not a clean studio photo, suggesting real but cluttered environment.
No photo of the machine powered on, stitching, or motor/pedal assembly provided.

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows visible rust, peeling paint, and worn/cracked table surface
no photo or video shows the machine running, stitching, or motor engaged
no supporting photo of functional use or completeness (motor, pedal, wiring) shown

risks.risk: Motor and foot pedal assembly may be missing or non-functional, common issue with resold industrial machines
risks.proof: A photo or clip showing the motor, belt, and pedal under the table, ideally powered on

risks.risk: Internal mechanism (hook, shuttle, tension discs) could be rusted or seized given visible external rust
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the internal bobbin area and a short video of the needle moving

risks.risk: Table and stand structural integrity compromised by visible cracks and water/stain damage
risks.proof: A photo of the full stand and legs, and a test of stability under light pressure
risks.if_unproven: priced as poor condition furniture base

risks.risk: Image may be a stock/reposted photo (watermark 'INNARA COLLECTION' suggests reuse), so actual item condition may differ from what is shown
risks.proof: A fresh photo with a handwritten note/date or timestamp from the seller
risks.if_unproven: priced at worst case condition as shown

proof_requests: Video of the machine running and stitching a sample cloth
Clear photo of the motor, pedal, and wiring underneath the table
Close-up of the bobbin/shuttle area showing no rust or jamming
Full-stand photo confirming structural stability of the table and legs
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a 'FLY' branded industrial sewing machine, but visible rust, wear, and absence of any working demonstration mean the 'good condition' and 'working perfectly' claims are unsupported, so it must be priced at worst case as a non-verified, visibly worn unit.
